page: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-8 is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance featuring 8 vCPUs and 30 GB of RAM, translating to 3.75 GB of memory per core. Built on the x86_64 architecture, this instance is powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8581C processors running at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. The hardware configuration includes 4 physical cores with 2 threads per core, supported by a cache hierarchy consisting of 48 KB L1d cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 260 MB L3 cache. It does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, and provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results show strong single-threaded performance, with Geekbench single-core scores reaching 2203.0 and text processing scores hitting 3031.0, both placing the instance in the top 10% tier. Single-threaded compression and decompression are also notable, with gzip compression at 34.68 GB/sec and bzip3 decompression at 14.84 GB/sec, both ranking in the top 25%. Multi-core and memory performance generally align with average mid-tier expectations, as demonstrated by a stress-ng multi-core score of 8425.22 and a Passmark CPU score of 12708.61. Large-block memory bandwidth reaches 61.17 GB/sec for read operations and 35.46 GB/sec for write operations.

The instance exhibits a clear performance tradeoff when handling larger workloads. While prompt processing for a medium 7B LLM model achieves an average speed of 56.94 tokens/sec, text generation for the same model drops to 7.18 tokens/sec, placing it in the bottom 25% tier. This indicates limitations for complex generative AI tasks without GPU acceleration. However, the presence of Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX-512) and Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) provides hardware-level acceleration for compatible mathematical and integer operations. Qualitatively, the c4-standard-8 offers a balanced resource density for compute-bound workloads that do not require local SSD storage. It is suitable for web serving, software compilation, text processing, and moderate database operations.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4-standard-8 is an x86_64 compute-optimized instance featuring 8 vCPUs and 30 GB of RAM, powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8581C processor at 2.3 GHz. It contains 4 physical cores with hyper-threading, a 260 MB L3 cache, and lacks local storage or GPU accelerators. Benchmarks highlight top-tier single-core performance, with Geekbench single-core and text processing scores in the top 10%, alongside strong single-threaded compression speeds. However, multi-core operations and memory bandwidth sit in the average tier, and text generation for 7B LLM models is weak at 7.18 tokens/sec. Supported by AVX-512 and AMX instruction sets, this instance is well-suited for web serving, software compilation, text processing, and moderate database workloads where local storage is not required.
